integrity: Proof is analytical. Finite exact arithmetic checks are supplementary. This is a self-review only; priority could be subsumed by broader conjugacy literature.
scientific_limitations: Regular orbit with piecewise-constant positive likelihood ratios and exogenous fixed node-activation order; no claims about discontinuity-crossing sensitivity, smoothly state-dependent probabilities, adaptive activation, or all forms of chaos. All-time bound is a branchwise differentiability result.
title: An exact telescoping sensitivity law for piecewise Bayesian opinion networks
